verdict.rationale: Integrating an external issue tracker is a fair question for a code host like Gitea, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only Gitea's built-in issue tracking, chat-app syncing (Slack, Discord), and a general API and webhooks, which are developer building blocks. Nothing documents viewing or managing external tracker tickets inside Gitea or linking to them from pull requests.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage tickets from an external issue tracker inside the code host and open them from pull requests
